target.statement: Average Precision of EIF+ on the TEP dataset (0.93)

compute.basis: TEP is a small public dataset (35,600 samples, 52 features); EIF+ training and evaluation on CPU takes seconds per the paper's reported fit times (~1 s), so the full protocol (download, install, run) should finish well under an hour.

title: Towards Transparent and Efficient Anomaly Detection in Industrial Processes through ExIFFI
